name: Monster Slayer
summary: A ranger who hunts vampires, dragons and other supernatural threats.

features.name: Monster Slayer Magic
features.short: Extra ranger spells you always know.
features.summary: You learn an additional spell at the listed ranger levels. They count as ranger spells for you but don't count against the number of ranger spells you know.

features.name: Hunter's Sense
features.short: Action: learn a creature's immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities.
features.summary: As an action, choose a creature within 60 ft.: you learn whether it has any damage immunities, resistances or vulnerabilities, and what they are. Uses: WIS modifier per long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Prey
features.short: Bonus action: mark a creature to deal +1d6 once per turn.
features.summary: As a bonus action, designate a creature within 60 ft.: the first time each turn you hit it with a weapon attack, it takes an extra 1d6 damage. Lasts until you rest or choose another target.

features.name: Supernatural Defense
features.short: Add 1d6 to saves and grapple escapes against your prey.
features.summary: Whenever the target of your Slayer's Prey forces you to make a save, or you try to escape its grapple, add 1d6 to the roll.

features.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
features.short: Reaction: foil a spell or teleport (WIS save).
features.summary: When you see a creature within 60 ft. casting a spell or teleporting, you can use your reaction to force a WIS save; on a failure the spell or teleport fails and is wasted. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Counter
features.short: Reaction: attack your prey when it forces a save; auto-succeed if you hit.
features.summary: When your Slayer's Prey target forces you to make a save, you can use your reaction to make a weapon attack against it. On a hit, you automatically succeed on the save.
